race.comment: Tricky staying race. WINSTON (3) continues to race well but finds it tough to win, third here last time out in a near identical affair. He'll roll across and take catching again in an open race at each way odds. BATOKA CHIEF (7) can mix form a bit but was good in town last time behind Shultzy which is solid form for this. Tricky draw but look for him late. THUNDERBOLT WAY (5) was somewhat of a surprise winner here last time out but was game on speed there beating POWER PIVOT (12) who ran on strongly to just miss. Both are in the mix off those runs, THUNDERBOLT WAY probably has map favours again.
